positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Computing Consultant
positions.description:
- Troubleshoot TCP/IP and network connections
- Resolve complex student account issues
- Develop methods for removing the latest malware infecting computers

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
- Tutor for Data Structures and Object Oriented Design, Programming Languages, and Compiler Construction under Christine Alvarado, Sorin Lerner, and Garo Bournoutian
- Help students understand complexity, generics, and debugging of code as well as functional programming concepts such as Map, Fold, and Filter
- Respond to student questions on Piazza forum
- Assist students with weekly programming assignments
- Assist the professor with grading exams

positions.title: System Admin Assistant
positions.description:
- Managed OUs in UCSD Active Directory 
- Designed and implemented software to address a variety of tasks
- Configured and troubleshoot network connections
- Upgraded system components, including memory, hard disks, video cards, etc.

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Provided tours to visitors
- Coordinated group visits such as school field trips and club trips
- Planned special events held at the museum such as rocket launching and teacher workshops
- Organized and executed children summer camps
- Monitored robotics lab where visitors programmed Lego robots to move around an artificial environment

projects.title: ReadMix
projects.description: Chrome browser extension that exposes explorative users to webpage elements and relevant online computer science curricula. The user is able to edit text of any website and is supplemented by explanations of the element they are interacting with. Implements JavaScript, HTML/CSS.

organizations.name: CODE2040
organizations.description: CODE2040 is a nonprofit organization that creates pathways to educational, professional, and entrepreneurial success in technology for underrepresented minorities with a specific focus on Blacks and Latino/as.

organizations.name: Eve Security
organizations.description:

- Create development groups to foster collaboration among members
